mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 48 degrees at Fireman's Park under clear skies with a waxing gibbous moon. Please note the air quality is currently moderate with an index of 71.

The city is moving forward with updates to the 2027 budget and several development proposals. The Plan Commission will meet on November 4th to discuss the Ardent Glen addition, new lots on Jenna Drive, and a site plan for 1979 Milky Way.

There is plenty to do around town. Today you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers' Market in Madison or enjoy the music series at Paddy Mac's.

In recent police news, on October 15th, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving. Fortunately, no students were injured during the incident.
For dessert lovers, today's flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and satisfy your sweet tooth.
